sources.name: model.info
sources.returns: ModelArtifact: classes, base model, val metrics, baseline metrics, train_seconds, onnx path, export check

sources.name: model.status
sources.returns: deployable (weights/onnx present), runs on this model, last run time, latest evaluation report id

sources.name: detections.frame
sources.returns: one image -> detections (class, score, box xyxy px), latency_ms, events for target_event

sources.name: detections.video
sources.returns: VideoRun: per sampled frame {frame_index, t_s, detections[]}

sources.name: counts.by_class
sources.returns: per class: detections, frames_with_class, max_in_one_frame, mean_per_frame. NOT unique objects

sources.name: timeseries.class_counts
sources.returns: per bucket of video time: max detections per class in one frame

sources.name: events
sources.returns: intervals where the TaskSpec trigger_class is present for >= min_consecutive_frames sampled frames

sources.name: evaluation.report
sources.returns: Damir's EvaluationReport: per model P/R/F1 with 95% CI, per class, readiness verdict

sources.name: counts.unique_objects
sources.returns: needs multi-object tracking across frames (not implemented)

sources.name: occupancy.percent
sources.returns: needs a known capacity or defined regions (zones) per camera

sources.name: history.wall_clock
sources.returns: runs are retained with created_at, but there is no continuous live-camera logging yet
